newsitem.title: USA: CD Radio completes preferred placement.
newsitem.headline: CD Radio completes preferred placement.

text.p: CD Radio Inc said on Thursday it completed a $135 million private placement of its five percent delayed preferred stock.

CD said it previously had received commitments to buy $200 million of the preferred stock subject to it winning a national satellite radio broadcast license, which it did on April 2 with an $83.3 million bid.
CD said it closed Wednesday on the sale of $86 million of the preferred stock, and exercised its right to close on additional commitments of about $49 million, for a total of $135 million.
The balance of $65 million in commitments will be allowed to lapse, the company said.
CD is developing a satellite-to-car, 50-channel radio service for delivery to motorists throughout the United States.
CD shares were trading up 7/8 to 12-3/8 at midday Thursday.
